subject: Mutual action plan & POC environment activation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan & POC environment activation

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday — excited to run the POC with AcmeHealth. To keep things tidy on our side and yours, I pulled together a short mutual action plan (attached) that maps the key checkpoints we agreed on and the technical prerequisites we need to unblock the environment. High level:

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for near-real-time clinical note summarization at pilot scale.
- Target POC window: 2–3 weeks after environment activation.
- Acceptance: 95% API availability during test window + sample throughput targets (details in MAP).

Immediate items we need from your infra team to provision the test environment:
1) IP allowlist entries (CIDRs) for outbound traffic to Redwood hosted endpoints (we'll provide endpoints once keys are minted).
2) VPC peering: single-subscriber peering from AcmeHealth-dev to redwood-poc-vpc (we use RFC1918 /27 for peering interface). Please confirm whether cross-account peering is ok or if you prefer transit routing via your hub.
3) Org-level setup: the AcmeHealth Redwood org ID and the primary admin email so we can invite your SREs.
4) A short-lived API key or a service account we can use to run smoke tests (we rotate these after validation).

I've attached the MAP template (redwood-map-template.xlsx) with milestones and recommended owners. Can you confirm points 1–3 and share the suggested CIDRs? If helpful, we can do a 30-min network sync with your infra folks — Marissa can coordinate.

Best,
Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: redwood-map-template.xlsx (Excel, 42 KB)

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & POC environment activation

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary and the MAP. We're aligned on goals. My infra lead asked me to pull together the initial details:

- IP CIDRs we can open from our side for outbound tests: 203.0.113.48/28 and 203.0.113.64/28 (temporary test window).
- VPC peering: we prefer a direct peering into our dev account (no transit). I'll have ops@acmehealth.com open a peering request; they will need target VPC ID + account.
- Org setup: primary admin is priya.sharma@acmehealth.com — please send the invite to that address.

Attached is our allowlist stub (acme-allowlist.txt) with the couple CIDRs and a brief note about our firewall schedule. Ops expects a network call to finalize routes; can you propose times tomorrow morning?

Also — does Redwood support asymmetric routing for the peering interface (we have a hub that does NAT for certain subnets)? We want to avoid surprises.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
CTO, AcmeHealth
priya.sharma@acmehealth.com

- I'll set up a 30-min network sync for tomorrow at 10:00 AM PT with Acme ops and our infra engineer (Connor). Please confirm if that works.
- We'll create a temporary scoped API key for the smoke tests. Karhtik, if you can confirm the exact hostname(s) and port we should expose in the MAP, we'll include them in the key policy.

Cheers,

Hi Priya — thanks for confirming the CIDRs and preference for direct peering. Quick update from our side after the internal prep:

- Peering details we will provide to your ops: redwood-poc-vpc (vpc-0a1b2c3d), account 987654321012, peering subnet allocation: 10.20.30.0/27 (peer interface).
- Temporary API key: we generated a scoped test key for the smoke run (rwi-temp-XXXXXX — stub shown in rwi-temp-key-stub.txt). This key is limited to inference.generate and expires 72 hours after activation. Please confirm when you'd like us to activate it.
- Org invite: invite sent to priya.sharma@acmehealth.com for AcmeHealth-dev org; once accepted we'll add your SREs automatically.

Next steps I propose (short checklist):
- Ops: accept peering and confirm route propagation (owner: Acme Infra)
- Redwood: activate temp key and whitelist the two CIDRs above (owner: Karthik)
- Joint: run smoke test suite (API latency, per-token throughput, and sample output quality) — target window 7/28–7/31
- Sign-off: POC acceptance by 8/1 (owner: Priya)

If this looks right, I'll lock milestones in the MAP and send an updated file with the peering values and invites.

Thanks,
